positive.prompt: Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that runs the tests on every pull request
Add a deploy stage to the pipeline with a manual approval gate
Automate the quality gates so nothing merges without passing checks
Add an axe or pa11y accessibility audit to CI for browser UI changes

negative.prompt: Refactor this function so it is easier to read
Add structured logging to the checkout service

evals.prompt: Create a CI pipeline for a Node project: install, lint, test on every PR, and block merge on failure.
evals.expected_output: A working workflow definition with correct triggers, steps, and failure behavior
expectations: The workflow triggers on pull requests
Failure of any quality gate fails the pipeline run
Steps are ordered logically and cache or setup steps are sane
No secrets are hardcoded in the workflow

evals.prompt: Add a CI job that runs accessibility checks for a React app without slowing down backend-only pull requests.
evals.expected_output: A CI plan or workflow that runs a11y audits for UI paths and avoids unnecessary browser work for backend-only changes
expectations: Accessibility checks are included using axe, pa11y, Lighthouse, or Playwright accessibility tests
The job is scoped to browser-facing or UI changes rather than every backend-only change
The workflow still keeps normal lint, test, build, and security gates intact
